sentences: Acyclicity means that a graph contains no cycle of the source's intended kind.
The saved entry asks whether this property can be tested using limited graph access.
The tester must discover evidence of cyclic structure when the graph is far from becoming acyclic.
Its difficulty depends strongly on whether cycles are directed and on how distance is normalized.
Because the inherited label does not specify those choices or the degree model, it cannot support a particular query bound or be silently specialized to forest testing.
